Responsible for ensuring proper function of anesthesia equipment in Operating Rooms including but not limited to: a. Provides daily inspection and calibration of all anesthesia machines. b. Provides for routine maintenance and repair of anesthesia equipment. c. Replaces anesthesia equipment as needed. d. Maintains a service log for anesthesia machines. Troubleshoots anesthesia machines and repairing within own limits

Responsible for ensuring proper cleaning of anesthesia equipment, instrumentation, supplies, storage carts, and related work areas including but not limited to: a. Reviews surgery schedule daily to anticipate anesthesia needs for equipment other than normal, assisting in any invasive procedure that may be required by the anesthesiologist b. Determines and maintains supplies ordered from Warehouse, Central Processing, and special outside orders. c. Maintains adequate supplies of all compressed gases (medical gases) used for surgical procedures. d. Participates in ongoing negotiations for anesthesia supplies and equipment. e. Maintains current knowledge of latex allergies

Provides consistency for the anesthesia group: a. Participates in product selection, evaluation, and conversion. b. Establishes and maintains standard carts and supplies at all facilities. c. Participates in anesthesia meetings and collaborating with anesthesiologists for decisions

Takes the initiative to continue to develop professionally and to provide development of other staff members as evidenced by the following: a. Demonstrates self directed learning and participating in continuing education to meet own professional needs as determined by the qualification requirements of this job. b. Participates in the development, implementation and attainment of department goals. c. Attends Surgical Services meetings, Anesthesia Committee meetings. d. Assists anesthesiologists with procedures as needed and within the scope of practice
Supports direct patient care personnel. Is available to assist surgical staff and physicians throughout surgical procedure including but not limited to equipment and supply
Perform disinfecting, cleaning and sterilizing of anesthesia related equipment. Knowledge of aseptic techniques.
Anesthesia Tech training or equivalent on the job training
Will be required to take call shifts as assigned
